title: Welcome to Amerika OS
tagline: Your own desktop, with Claude and ChatGPT at the centre.

steps.title: Welcome
steps.body: Amerika OS is a desktop for Ubuntu 26.10 on ARM64. It is built on the KWin compositor with Amerika's own shell. Other sessions on this computer are never changed.

steps.title: Look and feel
steps.body: The Amerika login screen and boot screen are optional. You can switch them on and off at any time, and the system falls back to the previous ones by itself if they fail to start.

actions.label: Use the Amerika login screen
actions.confirm: This changes the login screen from the next start. You can switch it off again in Settings.

actions.label: Use the Amerika boot screen
actions.confirm: This rebuilds the boot image (initramfs). If that fails, the previous screen is restored.

actions.label: Apply Amerika app defaults to my account

steps.title: Claude, ChatGPT and Amerika Agent
steps.body: Nothing is connected by default. Connect the AI apps you use in Settings; every action they take on this computer is shown, can be refused, and can be stopped with Ctrl+Alt+Esc.

steps.title: Updates
steps.body: Security updates and Amerika updates install automatically from the signed Amerika repository (stable channel). You can review them in Amerika Software.

steps.title: Help
steps.body: Manual pages: man amerika-flavour, man amerika-settings. Support and release notes are on the Amerika website.

notes: This is a data specification for the first-run welcome window; the shell UI (owned by the shell team) adopts it.
Commands are run without a shell, with argv exactly as listed. privileged:true commands go through pkexec and need a confirm text.
Steps are skipped in the live session (the installer is the first thing a live user needs).
